title.en: Saying goodbye to the teacher after school

goal.id: Adik dan Nenek berpamitan dan berterima kasih kepada guru saat dijemput pulang.
goal.en: Little sister and Grandma say goodbye to the teacher and thank her at pick-up time.

situation.id: Sore hari, guru mengantar murid-murid ke gerbang sekolah. Nenek datang menjemput Adik.
situation.en: In the afternoon the teacher walks the pupils to the school gate. Grandma has come to pick up little sister.

goal.id: Penjual ingin mengembalikan HP yang tertinggal di meja kasir.
goal.en: The shopkeeper wants to give back a phone left on the counter.

situation.id: Kakak baru saja membayar di toko kecil dekat kampus, lalu keluar. HP-nya tertinggal di meja kasir, dan penjual memanggilnya.
situation.en: Big brother has just paid at a small shop near campus and walked out. His phone is still on the counter, so the shopkeeper calls after him.

goal.id: Keluarga meminta meja untuk empat orang.
goal.en: The family asks for a table for four.

situation.id: Ayah, Ibu, Kakak, dan Adik masuk ke rumah makan. Ayah menghitung terlalu cepat dan lupa Adik yang berdiri di belakangnya.
situation.en: Dad, Mom, big brother and little sister walk into a restaurant. Dad counts too fast and forgets little sister, who is standing behind him.

lines.speaker: waiter
lines.en: Four? Sure, please have a seat.

title.en: Looking for milk at the supermarket

goal.id: Ibu ingin tahu di mana raknya susu.
goal.en: Mom wants to know where the milk is.

situation.id: Ibu belanja di supermarket dekat rumah dan tidak menemukan susu, jadi ia bertanya kepada petugas toko.
situation.en: Mom is shopping at the supermarket near home. She can't find the milk, so she asks a shop assistant.

lines.speaker: mama
lines.en: Hi, excuse me, where is the milk?

goal.id: Kakek ingin tahu siapa yang menumpahkan air di meja.
goal.en: Grandpa wants to know who spilled water on the table.

situation.id: Kakek masuk ke ruang tamu: ada air tumpah di meja, dan kucing duduk di sebelahnya. Adik ada di sofa.
situation.en: Grandpa walks into the living room. There is water all over the table, and the cat is sitting next to it. Little sister is on the sofa.

goal.id: Nenek ingin Kakak makan banyak, Kakak ingin sedikit saja; mereka tawar-menawar jumlahnya.
goal.en: Grandma wants big brother to eat a lot, he wants less, so they haggle over the number.

situation.id: Nenek baru selesai merebus pangsit dan mengisi piring Kakak.
situation.en: Grandma has just cooked dumplings and is filling big brother's plate.

lines.speaker: nainai
lines.cmn: 饺子好了！二十个，怎么样？
lines.en: The dumplings are ready! Twenty, OK?
lines.id: Pangsitnya sudah matang! Dua puluh, ya?

goal.id: Ibu ingin tahu apakah perempuan itu pacar Kakak.
goal.en: Mom wants to know whether the girl is big brother's girlfriend.

situation.id: Ibu menjemput Kakak di gerbang kampus. Sebelum Kakak datang, Ibu melihatnya mengobrol dengan seorang mahasiswi.
situation.en: Mom comes to pick up big brother at the university gate. Just before, she saw him chatting with a girl.

lines.speaker: gege
lines.en: No, no! She has a boyfriend.
lines.id: Bukan, bukan! Dia sudah punya pacar.

lines.speaker: mama
lines.en: And you? Do you have a girlfriend?

title.en: A friend's dog in the park

goal.id: Adik ingin tahu nama anjing temannya.
goal.en: Little sister wants to know the name of her friend's dog.

situation.id: Sore hari di taman, Adik bertemu teman sekolahnya yang sedang mengajak anjing jalan-jalan.
situation.en: In the park one afternoon, little sister runs into a school friend who is walking a dog.

goal.id: Ibu ingin memesan makan siang.
goal.en: Mom wants to order lunch.

situation.id: Siang hari Ibu masuk ke warung mi kecil dan duduk. Pelayan datang mencatat pesanan.
situation.en: At lunchtime Mom sits down in a small noodle shop. The waiter comes to take her order.

lines.speaker: waiter
lines.cmn: 包子没有了。有饺子和面条儿。
lines.en: We're out of baozi. We have dumplings and noodles.
lines.id: Bakpaonya habis. Ada pangsit dan mi.

goal.id: Kakek ingin tahu hari ini hari apa, karena ia kira hari ini Sabtu.
goal.en: Grandpa wants to know what day it is, because he thinks it is Saturday.

situation.id: Pagi hari Adik memakai tas sekolah dan siap berangkat. Kakek kaget, karena ia kira hari ini libur.
situation.en: In the morning little sister puts on her school bag, ready to leave. Grandpa is surprised: he thinks today is a day off.

lines.speaker: yeye
lines.en: It's Saturday today. You still have school?
lines.id: Hari ini Sabtu, kok kamu sekolah?

lines.speaker: meimei
lines.cmn: 今天不是星期六，是星期五！
lines.id: Hari ini bukan Sabtu, tapi Jumat!

lines.speaker: yeye
lines.cmn: 星期五？昨天不是星期五吗？

lines.speaker: yeye
lines.cmn: 星期四……对，对。那明天是星期六。
lines.en: Thursday... right, right. So tomorrow is Saturday.
lines.id: Kamis... oh iya, iya. Jadi besok Sabtu.

title.en: Making a plan on the phone

goal.id: Teman kuliah ingin janjian dengan Kakak besok untuk belajar bersama.
goal.en: A classmate wants to set a time with big brother to study together tomorrow.

situation.id: Teman kuliah Kakak menelepon. Mereka mau belajar bersama di toko buku besok dan perlu menentukan jamnya.
situation.en: Big brother's classmate calls him. They want to study together at the bookshop tomorrow and need to pick a time.

lines.speaker: classmate
lines.en: Hey, are you free tomorrow morning?

lines.speaker: gege
lines.en: Not in the morning. How about the afternoon?

lines.speaker: gege
lines.en: Half past two, at the bookshop. OK?
lines.id: Setengah tiga, di toko buku. Bagaimana?

lines.speaker: classmate
lines.en: OK, half past two. I'll wait for you there!
lines.id: Oke, setengah tiga. Aku tunggu di sana, ya!

title.en: Asking the way to the supermarket

goal.id: Nenek mencari supermarket terdekat.
goal.en: Grandma is looking for the nearest supermarket.

situation.id: Nenek berjalan di daerah yang belum ia kenal. Ia bertanya kepada penjual buah di pinggir jalan.
situation.en: Grandma is walking in a part of town she doesn't know well. She asks a fruit seller at a roadside stall.

lines.speaker: nainai
lines.en: Excuse me, is there a supermarket around here?
lines.id: Permisi, di sekitar sini ada supermarket?

lines.speaker: nainai
lines.id: Di belakang toko buku? Oke, terima kasih!

title.en: Stuck in traffic in a taxi

goal.id: Ibu ingin sampai di bioskop dan memutuskan turun lebih awal karena macet.
goal.en: Mom wants to get to the cinema and decides to get out early because of the traffic jam.

situation.id: Ibu naik taksi ke bioskop. Tidak jauh sebelum sampai, jalan macet.
situation.en: Mom takes a taxi to the cinema. Just before they arrive, the traffic stops.

lines.speaker: driver
lines.cmn: 好。……前头堵车了。电影院在那儿。
lines.en: OK. ... There's a jam up ahead. The cinema is just there.
lines.id: Baik. ... Di depan macet. Bioskopnya di sana itu.

lines.speaker: mama
lines.cmn: 那我在这儿下车吧。多少钱？
lines.en: Then I'll get out here. How much is it?
lines.id: Kalau begitu saya turun di sini saja. Berapa?

goal.id: Ibu ingin Kakak bangun untuk sarapan.
goal.en: Mom wants big brother to get up for breakfast.

situation.id: Sabtu pagi jam sepuluh. Kakak masih tidur, dan Ibu membangunkannya.
situation.en: It's ten o'clock on Saturday morning. Big brother is still asleep, and Mom comes to wake him.

lines.speaker: mama
lines.en: It's ten o'clock. Still not up?
lines.id: Sudah jam sepuluh, belum bangun juga?

lines.speaker: gege
lines.cmn: 今天星期六……我再睡一下。
lines.en: It's Saturday... Let me sleep a bit more.
lines.id: Ini kan Sabtu... Aku tidur sebentar lagi.

lines.speaker: mama
lines.en: OK, I'll call you again in ten minutes.
lines.id: Ya sudah, sepuluh menit lagi Ibu bangunkan.

title.en: What do you want for dinner?

goal.id: Ayah ingin tahu Adik mau makan malam apa.
goal.en: Dad wants to know what little sister wants for dinner.

situation.id: Ayah sedang di supermarket sepulang kerja dan menelepon ke rumah. Adik yang mengangkat.
situation.en: Dad is at the supermarket after work and calls home. Little sister answers.

lines.speaker: baba
lines.cmn: 喂，我在超市。晚上想吃什么？
lines.en: Hi, I'm at the supermarket. What do you want for dinner?
lines.id: Halo, Ayah di supermarket. Nanti malam mau makan apa?

lines.speaker: baba
lines.en: Dumplings? We had dumplings yesterday too.

goal.id: Ibu ingin tahu bagaimana hari Adik di sekolah.
goal.en: Mom wants to know how little sister's day at school went.

situation.id: Ibu menjemput Adik dan mereka berjalan pulang bersama.
situation.en: Mom picks up little sister and they walk home together.

lines.speaker: meimei
lines.en: Great! I have a new desk mate.
lines.id: Baik! Aku punya teman sebangku baru.

lines.speaker: mama
lines.cmn: 新同桌？男孩子还是女孩子？
lines.en: A new desk mate? A boy or a girl?
lines.id: Teman sebangku baru? Laki-laki atau perempuan?

lines.speaker: mama
lines.cmn: 学霸？那你也要好好学习。
lines.en: Super smart? Then you study hard too.
lines.id: Jago? Kalau begitu kamu juga harus rajin belajar.

goal.id: Kakek minta Adik membacakan dan membalas pesan dari Ibu.
goal.en: Grandpa asks little sister to read Mom's message to him and reply.

situation.id: Kakek dan Adik duduk di taman. Ada pesan dari Ibu di HP Kakek, tapi hurufnya terlalu kecil untuk Kakek.
situation.en: Grandpa and little sister are sitting in the park. Mom has sent a message to Grandpa's phone, but the text is too small for him.

lines.speaker: yeye
lines.cmn: 你妈妈写的什么？字太小了，你读一下。
lines.en: What did your mom write? The letters are too small, you read it.
lines.id: Ibumu tulis apa? Hurufnya terlalu kecil, coba kamu bacakan.

lines.speaker: meimei
lines.cmn: 我看看……她说她今天晚上八点回来。
lines.en: Let me see... She says she'll be back at eight tonight.
lines.id: Coba aku lihat... Katanya Ibu pulang jam delapan malam ini.

lines.speaker: meimei
lines.en: She says: you go ahead and eat.

title.id: Ke dokter karena tidak enak badan

goal.id: Kakak ingin tahu kenapa ia merasa tidak enak badan.
goal.en: Big brother wants to find out why he feels unwell.

situation.id: Sudah beberapa hari Kakak merasa tidak enak badan, jadi ia pergi ke klinik.
situation.en: Big brother has felt unwell for a few days, so he goes to the clinic.

lines.speaker: gege
lines.cmn: 医生，我这几天有点儿难受，不想吃饭。
lines.en: Doctor, I haven't felt well for a few days, and I don't feel like eating.
lines.id: Dok, beberapa hari ini saya agak tidak enak badan, tidak nafsu makan.

lines.speaker: doctor
lines.en: How are you sleeping at night?

lines.speaker: gege
lines.en: I go to bed at two or three every night.
lines.id: Saya tiap hari tidur jam dua atau tiga.

lines.speaker: doctor
lines.en: Two or three? What are you doing?
lines.id: Jam dua atau tiga? Kamu ngapain?

lines.speaker: gege
lines.en: I work a part-time job in the evenings.

lines.speaker: doctor
lines.cmn: 你要多休息，不要熬夜了。
lines.en: You need more rest. Stop staying up so late.
lines.id: Kamu harus banyak istirahat, jangan begadang lagi.

title.en: Bargaining for apples at the market

place.en: Fruit stall at the morning market

goal.id: Nenek ingin membeli apel dengan harga lebih murah.
goal.en: Grandma wants to buy apples for a lower price.

situation.id: Pagi hari Nenek belanja di pasar dan berhenti di lapak buah.
situation.en: In the morning Grandma goes shopping at the market and stops at a fruit stall.

lines.speaker: seller
lines.en: It's not expensive, they're really good!

lines.speaker: nainai
lines.cmn: 便宜一点儿吧，我买五个。
lines.en: Give me a better price, I'll take five.
lines.id: Kurangi sedikit, ya, saya beli lima.

lines.speaker: seller
lines.id: Ya sudah, lima jadi dua puluh.

goal.id: Ibu ingin Adik berhenti menonton di HP dan tidur.
goal.en: Mom wants little sister to put the phone away and go to sleep.

situation.id: Sudah malam. Ibu masuk ke kamar Adik dan melihat ia masih memegang HP.
situation.en: It's late. Mom walks into little sister's room and sees her still on the phone.

lines.speaker: meimei
lines.en: I'm not playing, I'm watching a film.
lines.id: Aku tidak main, aku nonton film.

lines.speaker: mama
lines.cmn: 看电影？你看了一个小时了！
lines.en: A film? You've been watching for an hour!
lines.id: Nonton film? Kamu sudah nonton satu jam!

lines.speaker: mama
lines.cmn: 好看也明天再看。现在睡觉！
lines.en: Then watch the rest tomorrow. Bed, now!
lines.id: Seru ya lanjut besok. Sekarang tidur!

goal.id: Ibu ingin membeli baju dengan ukuran yang pas.
goal.en: Mom wants to buy a top in the right size.

situation.id: Ibu melihat baju yang ia suka di toko baju. Penjual menyuruhnya mencoba, tapi yang pertama kebesaran.
situation.en: Mom sees a top she likes in a clothes shop. The assistant lets her try it on, but the first one is too big.

lines.speaker: seller
lines.en: Would you like to try it on?

lines.speaker: mama
lines.cmn: 嗯……有点儿大。有小一点儿的吗？
lines.en: (after trying it on) Hmm... it's a bit big. Do you have a smaller one?
lines.id: (setelah mencoba) Hmm... agak besar. Ada yang lebih kecil?

lines.speaker: mama
lines.en: This one fits. How much is it?
